notes.subject: בצנור
notes.rationale: The 'water-shaft/tsinnor': a tunnel up which attackers climb (ASV/BSB 'watercourse') vs Josephus 'gutters'; only here in Tanakh.

notes.subject: צנור
notes.rationale: Singular occurrence; the precise siege feature is unknown.

notes.subject: word order in v.8
notes.rationale: Whether the lame and blind are struck/struck-at (KJV) or reached via the tunnel, and whether שנאו is 'David's soul hates them' or 'they hate David's soul' — versions divide.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: נפש rendered as bel (inner self/appetite), not 'soul'.

translation: Na long dispela de David i tok: Man i kilim wanpela Yebusi, em i ken sanap long hul bilong wara, na ⟨את⟩ ol man i no inap wokabaut gut na ⟨את⟩ ol man i no inap luk — bel bilong David i les long ol. Olsem na ol i tok: Man i no inap luk o i no inap wokabaut gut, em i no ken kam insait long haus.
